title: Rethinking the Evaluation of LLM Fact-Checkers
abstract: arXiv:2610.30504v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to answer factual questions, but their answers can contain errors and must be fact-checked claim by claim. Yet the resulting score depends on three design decisions: which questions the claims answer, under what conditions each claim is judged, and which sources count as evidence. No existing benchmark specifies all three. We introduce JSFactCheckBench, a Japanese benchmark that specifies all three, with 1,913 claims from LLM answers to questions about misleading information that circulated on Japanese social media, each annotated for factuality at a reference time and for importance to the question, using evidence from preselected Web sources. Across six LLMs, all verify claims directly answering the question less accurately than supplementary claims, a gap that aggregate scores obscure. translated_title: 重新思考LLM事实核查器的评估
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被广泛用于回答事实性问题，但其答案可能包含错误，必须逐条声明进行事实核查。然而，由此产生的分数取决于三个设计决策：声明回答的是哪些问题、每条声明在什么条件下被判定、以及哪些来源算作证据。目前没有任何现有基准同时明确规定了这三点。我们推出了JSFactCheckBench，这是一个明确了这三点的日语基准，包含1,913条声明，这些声明来自LLM对曾在日本社交媒体上流传的误导性信息相关问题的回答，每条声明均在参考时间点标注了事实性，并标注了与问题的相关重要性，使用预先选定的网络来源作为证据。在六个LLM的测试中，所有模型对直接回答问题的声明的核查准确率均低于辅助性声明，而这一差距会被总体分数所掩盖。当模型必须在更长或多个来源中定位相关内容时，分数也会下降，并且对所有……
tldr: 提出了首个同时明确声明-问题关联、判定条件和证据来源三项设计决策的日语事实核查基准JSFactCheckBench，揭示了总体分数掩盖了模型核查直接回答问题的声明时准确率显著更低的现象。
en_tdlr: JSFactCheckBench, the first Japanese fact-checking benchmark specifying all three design decisions—claim-question relevance, judgment conditions, and evidence sources—reveals that aggregate scores obscure LLMs' lower accuracy in verifying claims that directly answer the question.
